title: reqQuest Framework Ownership — Role Catalog (roles.yaml)
description: Machine-readable projection of the human-facing stakeholder catalogue. Source of truth for the ownership validator (V1/V4/V5) and the CODEOWNERS generator. Contract defined in REQQF-ADR-GOV-100.

version.description: Optional schema-consumer version of this catalogue (major.minor).

roles.description: Map form is mandatory: the key IS the role id, which structurally guarantees uniqueness. List form is rejected: this schema requires an object.

propertyNames.description: Role id: role- followed by lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. role-maintainer, role-tech-lead (REQQF-ADR-GOV-100 D2).

handle.description: Host handle: @user, @org/team (GitHub) or @group/subgroup/... (GitLab nested groups). Username part allows '.' and '_' (valid on GitLab, e.g. @alice.smith); GitHub uses a subset. Verified against the host only at level `enforce` (rule V6).

title.description: Human-readable role name, mirrored from the stakeholder prose (K2).

handle.description: One handle, or a list of handles (flat variant — the whole team owns everything).

responsible_for.description: Subdirectories of requirements/ this role owns, as paths relative to requirements/ (business, functional/BOOKING), or `*` for the whole requirements/ tree (flat variant). A directory name has letters, digits, '_' and '-'. Leading or trailing slashes, dots (so no '..'), globs and a first segment `requirements` (requirements/business would mean requirements/requirements/business) are rejected, so every value stays inside requirements/ and the generated CODEOWNERS block, appended at the end of the file where the last matching pattern wins on GitHub, cannot take over paths outside it (REQQF-ADR-GOV-100 D2, D5). Two roles claiming the same directory is a hard error on GitHub (last-match-wins) — rule V5.

min_approvals.$comment: Optional, GitLab-only (section [Name][N]). Honoured on GitLab, ignored with a warning on GitHub where the approval count is repo-global, not per-path (REQQF-ADR-GOV-100 D8). Accepts a string form because the YAML loader (reqq_yaml, PyYAML BaseLoader) returns every scalar as text. Added to the schema now so extending roles.yaml later does not break existing adopters.
